name: LiveAgent
one_liner: LiveAgent provides a REST API (v3 being the current version) for managing agents, contacts, and tickets, authenticated via API keys.
access_note: API keys are generated within the LiveAgent account's admin panel, implying an existing subscription or trial.

evidence.quote: To be able to make API requests you need to generate an API key in your admin panel first.
1. Log in to your LiveAgent account. 2. Navigate to Configuration > System > API. 3. Generate or manage your API v3 key here.
If you are unsure which API version an endpoint belongs to, consult the Swagger API descriptor available in LiveAgent's documentation.
